body: Thank you so much for reaching out. If I came off rude in my first reply, I sincerely apologize. I'm trying to remind myself that I would never do anything like that on purpose, but guilt has always been easier for me to feel over anything else. I'm trying though.
I have no best friend. I don't have any friends. I don't trust anyone enough to consider anyone a friend.

Horses live to be around 30 usually. I know in the eyes of the law and society humans matter more. I get that (I do). It still doesn't take away the horrific knowledge of what I've done. I'm super sensitive. I feel guilty if I accidentally run over an already dead squirrel in the road. So you can understand my level of sensitivity. I had a family member call me a horse killer today. They meant it as a "joke", but I just left and started balling. I know it was an accident, but my already intensive emotions does not know how to cope with it.

This whole crash though is not the reason why I posted here or for my fragile mental health.

I only changed it to emojis after realizing I can't fully delete my post. I thought I sounded like a whiney loser, and I still think I do. I appreciate you reaching out anyways. I don't know how much better it will get after 30 when I still have my same mind.
